curation_note: Hand-curated facts, each with the place it was read. Bibliographic metadata was read from the Crossref REST API (https://api.crossref.org/works/<DOI>) on 2026-09-27. Open-access status was read from the Semantic Scholar Graph API (https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:<DOI>?fields=isOpenAccess,openAccessPdf) on 2026-09-27, and from the OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org/works/https://doi.org/<DOI>) where it answered before its anonymous daily budget was exhausted. Publisher pages were read with a plain HTTP fetch; HTTP 403 answers are recorded as such and not worked around. Dossier facts (energy ranges, processes, evidence classes, what each work could add) are quoted from docs/chemistry/n2_domain_extension/dx5/dx5_evidence_v1.json and are not re-derived here. Nothing was downloaded from behind a paywall; no author, lab or vendor was contacted.

rubric.status: PROPOSED (not in the RFP; for the owner to accept, change or replace)
rubric.purpose: Order the closed-access works by expected gap-closing value per unit cost, using only facts recorded in the D-X5 dossier.

reach_points.definition: Computed by the build script. The work's maximum stated energy (from the dossier) is compared with the target tables' source_last_data_point_eV and with the lane-01 E_req at the 1 % tail-share level for L = 60 eV (hold-envelope value, or the flat-sigma reference where no hold envelope exists), both read from docs/chemistry/n2_domain_extension/domain_extension_requirements.json. 'Reaches' means max_energy >= the smallest such E_req among the work's target tables for that gap.

cost.rule: No publisher showed a per-article price to the automated reader (see publisher_routes). Every work is therefore assigned cost_units = 1 (one article acquisition), evidence class 'assumed'. The owner replaces this with the prices seen in a browser; the build script then reorders.

rubric.value: sum over gaps of max(per_gap_floor, class + reach + sole + independent + penalties)
rubric.order: value / cost_units descending; ties broken by maximum stated energy descending, then by work_key ascending
rubric.proposed_acquisition_rule: PROPOSED: acquire in priority order until the owner's budget (TBD - requires the owner; 'reasonable cost' is the owner's judgement per od_hardware_pivot) is spent. Works sharing a publisher may be cheaper as a group through one institutional route; the grouping is listed but does not change the score.
